title: Morning Edition
intro: Today's briefing covers infrastructure, shifting AI timelines, company research on agent design, and market moves tied to AI and oil prices. Coverage spans global lessons on data centers to a prediction that self-improving AI could arrive by 2027.

items.title: What the US Movement Against Data Centers Can Learn From Abroad
items.summary: Paris Marx, author of Hyperscale, has been tracking global data center development for years. The US has a lot to learn from what’s happened everywhere from Ireland to New Zealand.
items.why: Lessons from other countries could inform US debates over data center siting and policy.
items.headline: what the US movement against data centers can learn
items.aiSummary: Paris Marx, author of Hyperscale, has tracked global data center development. Marx argues the US can learn from developments in countries including Ireland and New Zealand.

items.title: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark moves his prediction for self-improving AI forward to 2027
items.summary: A new benchmark by P-Zero Research measures how well AI models design and evaluate experiments on their own. The results are improving so fast that Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark now thinks self-improving AI could arrive by 2027. The article Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark moves his prediction for self-improving AI forward to 2027 appeared first on The Decoder .
items.why: Faster benchmark progress shifts timelines for when AI might autonomously improve its own designs.
items.headline: jack clark moves self-improving AI prediction to 2027
items.aiSummary: P-Zero Research released a benchmark that measures how well AI models design and evaluate experiments on their own. Results on that benchmark are improving quickly, leading Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark to move his prediction for self-improving AI to 2027.

items.title: Anthropic says one AI agent beats many subagents now that models can handle complexity alone
items.summary: Anthropic says companies should evaluate whether they can consolidate sub-agents into a single agent that loads context on demand. In one architecture comparison, the single-agent setup ran about twice as fast. Anthropic has published a migration kit on GitHub to help teams make the transition. items.why: Consolidating agents could simplify architectures and materially improve runtime performance.
